statements.t: This initiative is intended to enhance the value of our products and services, support our financial commitments and generate cost savings through 2030.
We expect to reinvest a portion of the savings generated by the initiative to support growth and innovation, while a portion will benefit operating results.

We manage the portfolio for long-term economics; therefore, we expect to hold a significant portion of these assets for the long term.

Given the quality and diversity of the underlying real estate, positive debt service coverage, loan-to-value ratio and significant borrower cash invested in the property generally ranging between 30% and 40%, we remain confident that the vast majority of borrowers will continue to perform as expected under their contract terms.

Although future losses remain possible due to further credit deterioration, we do not expect these losses to have a material unfavorable effect on our results of operations, financial condition or liquidity.
